This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **17** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/export-origins/root.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/shared.json`, `packages/spec/src/index.ts`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**22** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b81da66df773b5d237cad04d6b05a61e9544d553`.

⛔ **6** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/export-origins/root.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/shared.json`, `packages/spec/src/index.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **40** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **215** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **155** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **155**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **100** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **136** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b81da66df773b5d237cad04d6b05a61e9544d553` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c3966d044ded46ded39f2a766cf47cdea3b3e937` — the merge of head `247d0611fc164e95aedc91b213bd0642515b5760` into base `b81da66df773b5d237cad04d6b05a61e9544d553`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c3966d044ded46ded39f2a766cf47cdea3b3e937 && git checkout c3966d044ded46ded39f2a766cf47cdea3b3e937
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin b81da66df773b5d237cad04d6b05a61e9544d553 247d0611fc164e95aedc91b213bd0642515b5760 && git checkout -B drift-repro b81da66df773b5d237cad04d6b05a61e9544d553 && git merge --no-ff 247d0611fc164e95aedc91b213bd0642515b5760

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b81da66df773b5d237cad04d6b05a61e9544d553
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs b81da66df773b5d237cad04d6b05a61e9544d553` → pass the list as

## Contract review

Served-tier: 88/88 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `247d0611fc164e95aedc91b213bd0642515b5760`

Isolated at-tier reviewer subagent, run by the `domain:spec` seat-4 session; every one of its 88 transcript turns served at the tier the constant names. Continuation round after ruling A (`5814528240`). Landing class Tier H (`skills/**`): the maintainer's merge. Adopted by the seat 2026-09-24T19:18Z. The record below is the reviewer's, unedited except the two header lines.


Inputs read: card #19930 body and all 8 comments (triage `5805174208`, claim `5805510105`, round-1 report `5806147988`, decision analysis `5806180472`, release `5806192723`, ruling `5814528240`, re-claim `5819463080`, newest os-dev-report `5820368633`); `pulls/19943` (draft, base `main` at merge-base `61609edf8111aafe2285a0cb8cdd53b240b6d76e`, 17 files, 6 commits, +525/−176), `pulls/19943/files`, the PR's one issue comment (docs-drift bot), zero review comments, zero reviews; `commits/247d0611fc…/check-runs` (35 runs: 32 success, 3 skipped, 0 failure); git reads on `refs/review/pr-19943` and `origin/main` (now `fc6ddb87a4`, which has NOT moved any file under `skills/`, `packages/spec/scripts`, `packages/spec/src/shared`, `field.zod.ts`, `src/index.ts`, `export-origins` or `api-surface` since the merge-base: `git diff --name-only 61609edf8 origin/main -- those paths` is empty); AGENTS.md at `origin/main`; the seat's `body-proposed.md`. Nothing was written to GitHub or to any repository file; scratch only under `scratchpad/pr-19943/review/`.

### ① Derived judgments

**Ruling A, quoted from `5814528240`:** "An allowlisted pointer publishes when the file exists and ships (`*.zod.ts`), whether or not the textual import closure reaches it. The guard keeps its typo / dead-file half, and its reachability half becomes an existence check **for that list only**. `objectstack-i18n`'s `_index.md` stays byte-identical. query, api and automation lose only the helper-edge pointers their skills never taught. Every `_index.md` is regenerated by `gen:skill-refs`, ⛔ never by hand. ⛔ D refused … ⛔ B not taken."

**(a) The head implements A exactly; no widening beyond the list.**
- Publication condition = exists AND ships: `refs/review/pr-19943:packages/spec/scripts/lib/skill-map-guards.ts:287-289` `shipsFromSpec(rel, exists)` returns `rel.endsWith('.zod.ts') && exists(rel)`; `publishedPointers` (lines 361-373) adds each `allowed` row on `shipsFromSpec` alone and never consults `closure` for it.
- "Whether or not the closure reaches it": my independent re-derivation of the generator (script `review/sim-closure.mjs`, replicating `extractLocalImports`/`resolveAll`/`publishedPointers` over a `git archive` of the head) reports for `objectstack-i18n` `allowed-not-in-closure=[shared/identifiers.zod.ts,data/field.zod.ts]` — both rows are unreachable at the head and publish only by the new rule; at the merge-base the same list reads `allowed-not-in-closure=[]`.
- "For that list only": `publishedPointers` line 366 `if (allowed === undefined) return [...closure];` — a package with no list publishes its closure unchanged, exactly the pre-change `allowed === undefined ? resolved : …` at `61609edf8:packages/spec/scripts/build-skill-references.ts:438-441`. The existence predicate is applied only to `TRANSITIVE_ALLOWLIST` rows (`build-skill-references.ts:418-419` and `:437` at the head).
- Package WITH a list: pre-change published `resolved.filter((f) => coreSet.has(f) || allowed.includes(f))` (merge-base `build-skill-references.ts:441`), i.e. closure-only files were already excluded; post-change publishes `closure ∩ core` plus shipping allowed rows. Nothing that "the closure reached on its own" newly drops — it was never published for a listed package. Both listed packages (`objectstack-platform`, 5 rows; `objectstack-i18n`, 2 rows) produce identical pointer sets before and after (sim: platform `transitive=5` → `5`, i18n `2` → `2`). Packages without a list shrink only because the import edge is gone, which is what the ruling's third sentence accepts.
- Guard halves at the head (`skill-map-guards.ts:310-345`): typo half kept (package not in map), already-core and listed-twice kept, dead-file half now `!exists(rel)` (line 336), the reachability branch `!closure.has(rel)` deleted, plus a new refusal for a path outside `*.zod.ts` (line 330). That extra half enforces the ruling's own "ships (`*.zod.ts`)" clause on a hand-authored row and widens nothing that publishes (see ③, non-blocking).
- Wiring: `build-skill-references.ts:418-419` hands the guard `existsInSpecSrc` (disk), the up-front `closures` map is gone; `git grep 'closures\[skillName\]\|core closure imports it' 247d0611fc -- packages scripts` has no hit outside the guard test's negative assertion.

**(b) i18n byte-identical; the three removals are helper-edge pointers only.**
- `git diff --exit-code 61609edf8 247d0611fc -- skills/objectstack-i18n/references/_index.md` exits 0; the same against current `origin/main` `fc6ddb87a4` exits 0; blob `ce2cbeff8ba677510c0556703b4b37411d5f63f4` at all three refs. `git diff --name-status 61609edf8 247d0611fc -- skills/` lists exactly `api`, `automation`, `query` `_index.md` (the other six indexes unchanged).
- Removed rows read off the diff: query −6 (`data/field-value`, `data/field`, `kernel/metadata-protection`, `shared/expression`, `shared/identifiers`, `shared/value-domain`; keeps `shared/suggestions`), api −5 (`field-value`, `field`, `expression`, `identifiers`, `value-domain`), automation −4 (`field-value`, `field`, `data/filter`, `value-domain`). Sim counts: query 7→1, api 18→13, automation 11→7. The diffs are pure deletions; no retained row's description changed.
- Authored markdown check (every `.md` in each skill except `references/_index.md`, at the head): `git grep -n -E 'field-value|field\.zod|metadata-protection|expression\.zod|identifiers\.zod|value-domain' 247d0611fc -- skills/objectstack-query ':!…/_index.md'` → 0 hits; api pattern → 0 hits; automation pattern (with `filter\.zod`) → 0 hits. By exported identifier (script `review/ident-grep.mjs`, word-bounded over every `export` name of each removed file): 0 schema-level names; the only hits are ordinary words — `Field` (`skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md:115` "## Field References", `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md:344` a table header), `expression` (`skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md:6`, `rules/filters.md:242`), `Filter` (`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:200` "### Filter tokens (`config.filter`)"); api: 0 hits of any kind. The body's api example row exists at `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md:29`.

**(c) Public surface identical; the pin is weight-bearing with real controls.**
- Same name and signature: `247d0611fc:packages/spec/src/shared/field-type-suggestion.ts:122` `export function suggestFieldType(input: string): string[]` vs merge-base `suggestions.zod.ts` (deleted hunk) — the alias table (58 rows) and the function body are byte-identical; it still calls `findClosestMatches(normalized, FieldType.options)` with `findClosestMatches` imported from `./suggestions.zod` (line 5) and `FieldType` from `../data/field.zod` (line 3).
- Both entries: root barrel `src/index.ts:218-219` (`export { findClosestMatches, formatSuggestion } from './shared/suggestions.zod'; export { suggestFieldType } from './shared/field-type-suggestion';`), shared barrel `src/shared/index.ts:22` (`export * from './field-type-suggestion'`). Checked-in surface baseline `packages/spec/api-surface/{root,shared}.json:229/128` carry `"suggestFieldType (function)"` at both refs and `git diff --stat 61609edf8 247d0611fc -- packages/spec/api-surface` is empty; `export-origins/{root,shared}.json` moved the origin to `src/shared/field-type-suggestion.ts#suggestFieldType (function)` (the only two lines changed). No file at the head imports `suggestFieldType` from `suggestions.zod` (`git grep` empty); the one out-of-package consumer, `packages/metadata-core/src/object-field-type.ts:26`, imports from `@objectstack/spec/shared`, still served.
- Cycle really cut: `suggestions.zod.ts` at the head imports only `./alias-probe` and `./polarity-axes` (lines 5-9), both of which import nothing.
- Pin `packages/spec/src/eager-entry-import.test.ts`: derives its 17 entries from `package.json` `exports` (17 module subpaths + 2 data files confirmed from `247d0611fc:packages/spec/package.json`), spawns a fresh `node --import tsx` child per entry with `OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS=1` (lines 82-108), asserts exit 0. Controls are real: `247d0611fc:packages/spec/src/shared/lazy-schema.ts:34-37` returns `factory()` under the flag (a zod object → `typeof` `object`) and otherwise a `Proxy` over `function lazyZod() {}` (line 45, 125 → `typeof` `function`); `FieldSchema` (`data/field.zod.ts:1000`) and `ApiErrorSchema` (`api/contract.zod.ts:15`) are both `lazySchema`-wrapped and reach `./data` / `./api` via `export *` (`data/index.ts:132`, `api/index.ts:16`). 1 mapping + 17 flagged + 2 unflagged = the 20 tests reported. The ablations (A: re-close the edge → exactly `./data`/`./api` red; B: break the env hand-off → control 1 red) are the dev's runs, not re-run here (gate/test suites are off-limits to this review); the blob ids they cite match the head (`suggestions.zod.ts` `4ed9b1d8c6…`, `eager-entry-import.test.ts` `9e2b7b0fb5…`, `skill-map-guards.ts` `99c90e3e76…`).

**(d) Fences held.** Per-commit file lists (`git show --format= --name-only`) of the five authored commits `30ebee700c`, `1b2a2bb592`, `7d8a3800ef`, `fd9f55aadf`, `247d0611fc` contain neither `packages/spec/src/shared/lazy-schema.ts` nor `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`. Merge `1cda062eca` (parents `fd9f55aadf`, `61609edf81`): `git diff --stat 61609edf8 1cda062eca -- lazy-schema.ts field.zod.ts` is empty (it carries main's `lazy-schema.ts` byte-exact, +49/−2 vs the first parent), and `git diff --stat 61609edf8 247d0611fc` on both fenced files is empty. The merge's diff against main touches exactly the 11 round-1 files, and its hunks are identical to `git diff fdeeea0cc9 fd9f55aadf` (no branch-side edit smuggled into the merge).

**(e) Changeset and Clause-② consistent.** `247d0611fc:.changeset/19930-eager-first-import-cycle.md:1-3` `"@objectstack/spec": patch`; body states no accept/reject change and unchanged exports. AGENTS.md at `origin/main` line 1070-1072: a bug fix in a released package takes `patch`; `Clause-② yes` = "this PR puts a new key on a published payload" (`scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs:884-885`) and must grade at least one moved package `minor`. A declaration-site move with an unchanged `api-surface` baseline adds no key and no export, so `Clause-②: no` with `patch` is the consistent pair; `Check Changeset` is green. `scripts/` and `skills/` are outside the package `files` allowlist (`dist, json-schema, liveness, prompts, llms.txt, README.md, src/**/*.zod.ts, CHANGELOG.md, api-surface, spec-changes.json`), so the round-2 files publish nothing and the round-1 changeset still describes everything that ships.

**(f) The `_index.md` files are the generator's output.** Check-run `Type Check · source gates` (job 107770057651) at head `247d0611fc…` completed `success`, step "Check generated skill references are in sync with the spec" (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-refs`) `success`; "Check generated reference docs…", "Check the export-origins baseline resolves as recorded", "Published skills token ratchet" all `success`. Independently, `node review/sim-closure.mjs head` reproduces all 9 indexes at the head ("ALL 9 MATCH", pointer sets and emit order) and `… mb` reproduces all 9 at the merge-base with the pre-change filter, giving the 7/18/11 → 1/13/7 transition from the generator's own logic, not from hand edits.

**Landing class:** `skills/**` is on the Tier H row (AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14, lines 257-273: "one Tier H path makes the whole PR Tier H … Tier H (人合: … `skills/**` …)"), and the ruling `5814528240` says "The PR then lands **Tier H** (`skills/**`) on the maintainer's merge". ⇒ **Tier H, the maintainer's merge**; no seat lands, queues or arms it.

**Proposed body (`body-proposed.md`) against the head:** every sentence I could test holds — `Fixes #19930` / `Clause-②: no`; the load-chain line refs at `fdeeea0cc9` (`filter.zod.ts:4`, `strict-object.ts:83`, `suggestions.zod.ts:4`, `field.zod.ts:1000`, `field.zod.ts:1529` `relatedListFilter: FilterConditionSchema.optional()`) are exact; the three importer edits, the export-origins lines, the guard halves, the `publishedPointers` contract, the wiring pin, 36 tests (31 `it(` + 5 `it.each` rows), the ablation blob ids, i18n byte-identity, the three removed-pointer lists, "17 today", 44 dist JS files in the exports map, 326 files in the merge with `lazy-schema.ts` and `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` from main and no `_index.md`/`skill-map-guards.ts`, 5260 export-origins entries across 17 files, 17 files +525/−176 whole-branch and 6 files +193/−74 this round, the acceptance-note comment sites (`field-value.zod.ts:35`, `field.zod.ts:184`, `strict-object.ts:213/227/318`, `strict-object.test.ts:438/488` still describe the old edge). Not independently reproducible here (local measurements, not gate output): the 1039/1040-module sweep counts, the dist `.build-input-hash`, the vitest/typecheck totals — CI's green runs corroborate the gate-level claims. One imprecision, noted in ③.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@objectstack/spec` is right. No export added, removed or renamed (api-surface baseline byte-identical at `root.json:229` and `shared.json:128`); `suggestFieldType` keeps its name, `(input: string): string[]` signature, alias table and answers; no schema accepts or rejects differently; `scripts/` and `skills/` are not published by npm. `Clause-②: no` is the only consistent declaration for a diff that puts no new key on any published payload; a `minor` would be a self-contradiction under `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- non-blocking — The guard gained a fourth refusal, "not a `*.zod.ts` path" (`skill-map-guards.ts:330-334`), beyond the ruling's enumerated "typo / dead-file half". It applies to allowlist rows only, enforces the ruling's own "ships (`*.zod.ts`)" condition, and refuses loudly rather than dropping a pointer silently; nothing that publishes is widened.
- non-blocking — The register carve-out for generator-owned `skills/**` outputs (`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs:385-411`, maintainer ruling #11705) can lift a `_index.md`-only path hit when the checker proves per-file reproducibility. The ruling on this card nonetheless names Tier H on the maintainer's merge, so the seat should treat this PR as Tier H regardless of what the queue guard would compute.
- non-blocking — Merge commit `1cda062eca` carries no `Claude-Session` / `Co-authored-by` trailer pair; it is the `git merge --no-edit` auto-commit that `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` prescribes (its own comment at line 221). The five authored commits carry the model-free pair AGENTS.md line 451-452 requires.
- non-blocking — Body wording: "`packages/spec/src/shared/lazy-schema.ts` (+51, …)" — the merge's change to that file is +49/−2 (51 lines touched, not 51 additions). Suggest "51 lines" or "+49/−2".
- non-blocking — The ruling's remaining execution steps are not yet visible on the PR: it is still draft, `requested_reviewers` is empty (ruling asks for `os-zhuang` / `hotlong`), and the 维护者速读 lives in the proposed body, not yet on the card. These are the seat's post-review actions, not defects of the head.
- non-blocking — Historical prose still describing the removed edge (`docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.md:399`, dated ledger; `docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md:306`) is not shipped customer text and states nothing about the declaration site; consistent with the body's "noted, not filed" acceptance notes.
- non-blocking — `origin/main` advanced to `fc6ddb87a4` after the merge; the four added files are unrelated `.changeset/*.md` entries and nothing on this PR's surface moved, so the head needs no re-merge for review purposes.
